Its principal assets comprise office premises at Jolly Bhavan No. 1, New Marine Lines, Mumbai and fixed deposits placed with banks, with income derived substantially from interest earned on those deposits. risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The erstwhile manufacturing facility and the furniture business remain discontinued and the Company had no manufacturing or trading operations during the year, so there is no revenue from operations to support the entity.
- Principal assets are office premises and fixed deposits with banks and income is derived substantially from interest earned thereon; management explicitly states the Company 'remains exposed to interest rate risk'.
- The Company continues to incur fixed regulatory and listing compliance costs while earning only interest income, which keeps the entity structurally loss-making at the pre-tax level.
- The Board is still evaluating options for the prudent deployment of surplus funds and for the Company's future business direction; no successor business has been identified.
- The remaining office premises are being sold to The New Great Eastern Spinning and Weaving Company Limited, a promoter group company, leaving the Company holding cash and only a 250 sq. ft. leave-and-license footprint in the same premises.
- The transaction of scale during the year was with a promoter group company, and the Company's continued occupation of premises depends on a leave and license arrangement with that same counterparty.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Remain without manufacturing or trading operations, holding office premises and bank fixed deposits while meeting fixed regulatory and listing compliance costs
- Monetise the Mumbai office premises through the board- and shareholder-approved sale to a promoter group company, retaining only a 250 sq. ft. leave-and-license footprint
- Board to continue evaluating options for the prudent deployment of surplus funds and for the Company's future business direction
- Conserve resources for future business requirements — no dividend and no transfer to the General Reserve
